outcome: depressive symptoms (measured by Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology score)
increase in Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology score
cohort: The study included women with a hypertensive disorder of pregnancy at >=34 weeks' gestation with singleton gestations.
finding: Peripartum magnesium sulfate was associated with a significantly smaller change in mean Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology score and a lower likelihood of increased depressive symptoms at 2 weeks after delivery, but not at 6 weeks.
